description: Hand clap built by modelling a 909-like analogue circuit; it has no pitch, and a small reverb stands in for the room

params.text: How much filtering is applied to the clap
How hard the clap transient hits
Diffusion of the reverb around the clap
Click to sound the clap once
How strongly an accent changes the hit

inputs.text: A trigger here sounds the clap
Modulates how hard the clap transient hits
A voltage here accents the hit as it is triggered; on some drums that means more level, on others a sharper transient with more harmonics
Modulates the diffusion of the reverb

notes: there is no sequencer or clock here; the drum sounds once for each trigger patched in, or each click on its button
